rows.label: Mental model and smallest artifact
requiredText: Choose the smallest artifact that satisfies the user's verb.

rows.label: Session preflight
requiredText: Before Alva work, read [preflight.md](references/preflight.md), run current command help, and confirm identity.

rows.label: Financial-data provenance
requiredText: Financial facts require fresh Data Skills, feed, or validated BYOD/search provenance; never use model memory as data.

rows.label: Financial Analysis answer gate and disclaimer
requiredText: Before Financial Analysis answers, read [user-facing-prose.md](references/user-facing-prose.md), pass the answer gate, and include the mandatory investment disclaimer for any security price or strategy.

rows.label: Automation knowledge
requiredText: Before automation work, read [alva-knowledge.md](references/alva-knowledge.md); use bounded history when useful and suppress non-material push repeats.

rows.label: New Automation push default
requiredText: New Automations default to `--push-notify`; read [feed-lifecycle.md](references/feed-lifecycle.md) and [push-notifications.md](references/push-notifications.md) for producer and subscriber verification.

New Automation producers include `--push-notify` by default unless the user explicitly opts out; read [deployment.md](references/deployment.md), [feed-lifecycle.md](references/feed-lifecycle.md), and [push-notifications.md](references/push-notifications.md) for the full lifecycle and delivery contract.

rows.label: Skillhub blueprints
requiredText: For `/use-skill:` or a named method, fetch the Skillhub blueprint fresh and preserve its `--skill-id` when releasing.

rows.label: Altra strategy ownership
requiredText: Use Altra for every backtest, strategy, signal, portfolio simulation, order stream, or rebalance.

rows.label: alpi reasoning boundary
requiredText: Use alpi only for scheduled reasoning over real upstream data, never to invent financial facts.

rows.label: Playbook and release gates
requiredText: For hosted playbooks, build live feeds before HTML, then pass README, lint, screenshot, and release gates.

rows.label: Alert contract
requiredText: For alerts, declare the alert output and verify publisher push, active automation binding, and intended subscriber without claiming delivery.

rows.label: Remix route and preservation boundary
requiredText: Remix; read [remix-workflow.md](references/remix-workflow.md), inspect source scripts, HTML, README, metadata, and UDFs, and preserve lineage and source UDFs.

rows.label: Annotation edit route and generator boundary
requiredText: Edit / Debug; read [annotation-edits.md](references/annotation-edits.md) and edit the generator behind the element, never rendered feed values.

rows.label: Trading confirmation
requiredText: Actual orders require a dry run and explicit user confirmation before non-dry-run execution, except the documented channel-loop consent path.

rows.label: User namespace scope
requiredText: Write, deploy, publish, release, and visibility operations stay in the requesting user's namespace unless explicitly authorized otherwise.

rows.label: Reference ownership
requiredText: Top-level guidance routes decisions; focused references own commands, examples, gotchas, and detailed checklists.

rows.label: User-facing communication
requiredText: Lead user-facing updates with the verified result, provenance, and remaining issue; omit unnecessary internal machinery.

rows.label: Final verification checklist
requiredText: Before finishing, verify the selected route's required references, data provenance, hard gates, user scope, and delivered artifact.
